scripts.build:love: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path game.love) { Remove-Item game.love } ; Compress-Archive -Path main.lua, conf.lua, lib, img -DestinationPath game.zip -Force ; Rename-Item game.zip game.love"
scripts.build:web: echo '' | node node_modules/love.js/index.js game.love dist -c -t Sweeper && node scripts/clean-html.js
scripts.build: npm run build:love && npm run build:web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
